synopsis: By the age of five, she was humming melodies. By 10, she had found a jewel. By 14, the world has lost its sparkle. At 17, she hears the sound of rebirth. Tsukimori Mone is a slightly sassy high school girl who has someone she can never forget. What is Mone's past that only Anji-senpai knows…? A moving love story of love and rebirth begins! (Source: Kodansha, machine translated)

title: Shippo to Gekirin
titleNative: しっぽと逆鱗
synopsis: Aki Miyama is a beastkin who has lived a quiet, unassuming life, blending in seamlessly among humans. Then, one day—quite out of the blue—a beastkin child named Tsukiko suddenly tumbles into his life! Thus begins a shared existence born of a chance encounter between two polar opposites: a socially awkward adult and a guileless, earnest child. Together, they make a home—striving to survive in a world that was never built for the likes of them. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

titleRomaji: Tensei Youjo. Shinjuu to Ouji to, Saikyou no Oji-san Youheidan no Naka de Ikiru.
titleEnglish: The Reincarnated Little Girl Lives With Divine Beast, Prince, and Mercenaries of Tough Guys
titleNative: 転生幼女。　神獣と王子と、最強のおじさん傭兵団の中で生きる。
synonyms: Reincarnated Girl: Living With a Beast, a Prince, and The Strongest Mercenary Group
synopsis: Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members! (Source: Alpha Manga)

synonyms: After School, We Wander in Space.
synopsis: Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded — blowing away their dream of reaching space with it — but that wasn't the only thing that blew up in that video. Ayame Madoi, a girl who worked on the engine section who happened to appear in the vlog, also exploded in popularity when viewers from across the world found her cute. While she finds this attention bewildering, she actually already has someone she wishes would notice her that way… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)
